charts.title: WASP-38 b: orbits around WASP-38
charts.description: The orbits of WASP-38's planets in this map from above, to scale, with WASP-38 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Kokori et al. 2023 (2023ApJS..265....4K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname KOKORI_ET_AL__2023): P 6.8718851 d
